name: insyte-monorepo
description: Root convenience scripts only. The real projects are website/ (Vite + Express, deployed to Vercel + Railway) and app/ (Expo native). Each installs its own dependencies independently — deliberately NOT npm workspaces, so a native-only dependency can never leak into the deployed website build.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix website exec tsc -- --noEmit && npm --prefix app exec tsc -- --noEmit
